modern: 乾统三年，徙封为秦国公。
classical: 乾统三年，徙封秦国。
english: In the third year of the Qingtong Era, he was re-enfeoffed as Prince of the Qin State.

modern: 王莽时叫监工苏。
classical: 莽曰监邛。
english: It was called Jianggongsu in Wang Mang's time.

modern: 初十，把恢复设置尚书省的决定诏令天下。
classical: 辛未，以复置尚书省诏天下。
english: On the tenth day of the first lunar month, an imperial edict was issued to restore the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

modern: 《司马法》广泛陈述了上古三代的制度，其中说：古代六尺为一步，百步为一亩，百亩为一夫，三夫为一屋，三屋为一井田。
classical: 《司马法》广陈三代，曰：古者六尺为步，步百为亩，亩百为夫，夫三为屋，屋三为井。
english: The Book of Sima's Military Methods extensively described the systems of the Three Dynasties of antiquity, stating that: in ancient times, six chi (feet) equaled one bu (step), one hundred bu equaled one mu (acre), one hundred mu equaled one fu (man), three fu equaled one wu (group), and three wu equaled one jingtian (well-field).

modern: 事情结束以后，加封仇士良为特进、右骁卫大将军，封鱼弘志为右卫上将军兼中尉，封宋守义为右领军卫上将军。
classical: 事平，加特进、右骁卫大将军，弘志右卫上将军兼中尉，守义右领军卫上将军。
english: After the incident had ended, Qiu Shiliang was enfeoffed as Special Advance and General of the Right Valiant Guards, Yu Hongzhi was enfeoffed as General of the Right Guards and Lieutenant General, and Song Shouyi was enfeoffed as General of the Right Leading Army Guards.

modern: 为此忠臣扼腕、义士痛心，家家视宋朝为敌，人人百倍激发勇气，失道至此，虽想不亡国能办到吗？
classical: 是以忠臣扼腕，义士痛心，家与为仇，人百其勇，失道至此，虽欲不亡得乎？
english: So the loyal retainers twisted their hands in anguish and the chivalrous men gnashed their teeth with rage. Every family regarded the Song Dynasty as their enemy; every man's courage was multiplied a hundred times. After this loss of popular support, is it possible to prevent the nation from falling?

modern: 诏书既下，不要拖延，刺史明加督察那些罪恶特大的人。
classical: 诏书既下，勿得稽留，刺史明加督察尤无状者。
english: <translation>Now that the诏书 has been issued, don't delay, and prefects should be clear about supervising those who have committed especially heinous crimes.

info: 《太平广记·卷一百四十四·征应十》
modern: 他常住的屋墙上有笔洒的墨迹。
classical: 其所常居室壁，有笔洒墨迹者。
english: There were traces of spilled ink on the walls of the house where he lived.

modern: 皇帝发怒，逮捕唐胄关进钦犯狱。
classical: 帝怒，下胄诏狱。
english: The emperor was so angry that he had Tang Zhou arrested and put in the prison for serious criminals.

modern: 僖公与齐侯、宋公、陈侯、卫侯、郑伯、许男、曹伯在鹹地会见。
classical: 公会齐侯、宋公、陈侯、卫侯、郑伯、许男、曹伯于鹹。
english: Duke Xi met with the marquises and dukes of Qi, Song, Chen, Wei, Zheng, Xu and Cao at Handi.

modern: 凡是俗事，昱看一下就会，锻铸锡金银，缝衣作帽，技艺都很高超。
classical: 凡诸鄙事，过目则能，锻炼金银，裁衣作帽，莫不精绝。
english: Yu had a knack for all kinds of mundane tasks, and was highly skilled in forging tin, gold, and silver and in sewing clothes and making hats.

modern: 十八日，淮西路的正阳发生火灾，房屋、兵甲器仗全部被烧毁，对万户爱先不花等处以轻重不同的杖刑。
classical: 庚申，淮西正阳火，庐舍甲仗焚荡无余，杖万户爱先不花等有差。
english: On the 18th, a fire occurred in Zhengyang, Huaibei Road, burning down houses, weapons, and military supplies. The 10,000 households led by Ai Xian Buhua were given different severity of punishments.

modern: 他对官府是非的评论，绝不附和，耸立如泰山，绝不回头。
classical: 及其临政决议，意所背乡，屹若泰山，不可回夺。
english: His comments on the right and wrong of the government were never flattering, and he stood like Mount Tai, never looking back.

modern: 但是，别人施行此术或者还能解除，唯独王升施行此术时，非沉船不可。不知究竟是不是这小子干的。
classical: 然他人或有以解，唯王升者犯之，非没溺不已，则不知果是此子否。
english: However, when others practice this technique, they can still be lifted, but when Wang Sheng practices this technique, the ship must sink. I wonder if this kid did it.

modern: 顺山麓往北行，越过两条小涧，共走四里，经过紫云山山麓，江流从东北面流来，从此处流入山峡中，路也顺流而去。
classical: 循山麓北行，逾小涧二重，共四里，过紫云之麓，江从东北来，从此入峡，路亦随之。
english: I walked north along the base of the mountain, crossed two brooks, walked a total of four miles, passed the base of Ziyun Mountain, and the river flowed from the northeast into a canyon here, and the road also followed the direction of the current.

modern: 太初元年夏季，蝗虫从东方飞到敦煌；三年秋季，再次发生蝗灾。
classical: 太初元年夏，蝗从东方蜚至敦煌；三年秋，复蝗。
english: In the summer of the first year of the Taichu reign, locusts flew from the east to Dunhuang; in the autumn of the third year, a locust disaster occurred again.

modern: 至元六年，拜光禄大夫、御史大夫。他将朝野内外一些廉能之官选为御史，故为当时人称赞不已。
classical: 至正六年，拜光禄大夫、御史大夫，尽迁中外廉能之官置诸风宪，一时号称得人。
english: In the sixth year of the Yuan Dynasty, he was awarded Guanglu Dafu and Yu Shi Dafu. He selected some honest officials inside and outside the court as 御史, so he was highly praised by people at that time.

info: 《战国策·齐三·国子曰秦破马服君之师》
modern: 魏国公子无忌为天下设下妙计，杀死将军晋鄙，率领魏国军队去解救邯郸之围。使秦国不能占领邯郸而且失去天下民心。
classical: 公子无忌为天下循便计，杀晋鄙，率魏兵以救邯郸之围，使秦弗有而失天下。
english: Wei's noble, Wuji, created a wonderful plan for the world, killed General Jin Bi, and led Wei's army to break the siege of Handan. The Qin state couldn't occupy Handan and also lost the hearts of the people of the world.

modern: 将名字列好，上报尚书，由尚书再次核实。
classical: 列上尚书，覆其合否。
english: The list of names should be submitted to the Minister of the Ministry of Works, who will verify it again.

modern: 过了一百五六十年，唐宪宗时有朱邪尽忠及子执宜到了中原地区，自号沙陀，以朱邪为姓。
classical: 后百五六十年，宪宗时，有硃邪尽忠及子执宜见于中国，而自号沙陀，以硃邪为姓矣。
english: One hundred and fifty-six years later, during the reign of Emperor Xianzong of the Tang Dynasty, Zhuye Jinzhong and his son Zheyin arrived in the Central Plains, proclaimed themselves Shatuos, and took the surname Zhuye.

modern: 征西参军孙盛悄悄地劝谏庾亮说： 王公经常有辞绝政事、优游于尘世之外的愿望，怎么会干俗人所干的事情呢！
classical: 征西参军孙盛密谏亮曰： 王公常有世外之怀，岂肯为凡人事邪！
english: Sun Sheng, the adjutant of the expedition to the West, secretly advised Yu Liang, saying: "Wang Gong has always had the desire to give up political affairs and live in seclusion. How could he do the things that ordinary people do!"

modern: 皇五年正月，会灵宫失火。这年冬至，郊祀天地，以三帝配享天地神。
classical: 皇祐五年正月，会灵宫灾，是岁冬至，郊，以二帝并配。
english: In the first month of the fifth year of Emperor Huang, Huiling Palace was burnt down. In the winter solstice of that year, worshiping heaven and earth and enshrining three emperors to worship heaven and earth gods.

modern: 显祖不念情于世务，经常有出世之心，打算把皇位禅让给叔父京兆王拓跋子推，事见《任城王云传》，群臣坚决请求他别这样做，显祖只好作罢。
classical: 帝雅薄时务，常有遗世之心，欲禅位于叔父京兆王子推，语在《任城王云传》。群臣固请，帝乃止。
english: Emperor Xianzu had no interest in the affairs of the world and often had thoughts of leaving the world behind. He planned to pass on the throne to his uncle, King Jingzhao Tuoba Zitui. This can be seen in the "Biography of King Rencheng, Yun." The ministers all strongly opposed this, and Emperor Xianzu had no choice but to give up.

modern: 年十九岁时，任宣武军军校。
classical: 年十九，为宣武军校。
english: At the age of nineteen, he became a military officer of the Xuanwu army.

modern: 传令张步到行辕，而勒兵进据其城。
classical: 弇传步诣行在所，而勒兵入据其城。
english: Order Zhang Bu to go to Xingyuan and advance into his city.

modern: 归属户，是边地的卫国屏障。
classical: 属户者，边垂之屏翰也。
english: The subordinate households are the country's shield on the border.

modern: 晋代之乐如《正德》、《大豫》，到了塞伐也不改换名称，衹是称为《前舞》、《后舞》，这种依据前代的做法，是不合事理的。
classical: 晋氏之乐，《正德》、《大豫》，及宋不更名，直为《前》《后》二舞，依据昔代，义舛事乖。
english: Jin-dynasty music like Zhengde and Dayu did not change their names even after moving to Saiwa. They were only called "front dance" and "back dance". This practice of following former generations is unreasonable.

info: 《太平广记·卷四十五·神仙四十五》
modern: 又和诸弟子告别，就乘风离去了，渐渐远了，以至不见。但隐隐约约还能听到各种音乐的声音。
classical: 复与诸徒诀别，乘风遂去，渐远不见，隐隐犹闻众乐之音。
english: He bid farewell to the disciples again, and rode the wind and left, gradually going farther and farther until he was out of sight. But one could still faintly hear the sound of music.

modern: 太宗派部尚书刘德威前往按察，上告事多有验证，太宗下诏令李与权万纪一同入朝。
classical: 上遣刑部尚书刘德威往按之，事颇有验，诏祐与万纪俱入朝。
english: Taizong sent Minister of Works Liu Dewei to investigate the matter, and most of the accusations were verified. Taizong issued an imperial edict ordering Li and Quan Wanji to come to the court together.

modern: 兄弟四人中先在并州的人，晋升了官爵。
classical: 兄弟四人先在并州者，进官爵。
english: Among the four brothers, those who first arrived in Bingzhou were promoted in rank and title.

modern: 十七日托金祥甫再次恳求内司给予救助，这不过是为静闻请命而已。
classical: 十七日托金祥甫再恳内司，为静闻请命而已。
english: On the 17th, he asked Jin Xiangfu to once again implore the Imperial Household Department for assistance, which was only to ask for help for Jingwen.

info: 《太平广记·卷一百七十四·俊辩二》
modern: 庾公又问齐庄叫什么名字，齐庄说：齐庄。
classical: 又问齐庄何字，答曰：齐庄。
english: Governor Yu asked Qi Zhuang, “What is your name?” Qi Zhuang replied, “Qi Zhuang.”

info: 《太平广记·卷二百零一·才名（好》
modern: 唐玄宗听说李白的诗名，下诏书召他入翰林院。
classical: 玄宗闻之，召入翰林。
english: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang heard about Li Bai's reputation and issued an imperial edict to summon him to the Hanlin Academy.

modern: 绍熙二年，施师点拜官隆兴府知府、江西安抚使。
classical: 绍熙二年，除知隆兴府、江西安抚使。
english: In the second year of the Shaoxi era, Shi Shiping was appointed Prefect of Longxing and Pacification Commissioner of Jiangxi.

modern: 一百零二篇的作者是哪个？
classical: 百二篇何所造？
english: Who is the author of the one hundred and two chapters?

modern: 当时因寡不敌众，乃退入城中，与星全力战守城。
classical: 时以众寡不敌，乃退入城，复与企力战拒守。
english: Since their army was outnumbered, they retreated to the city and defended it all out.

modern: 拖欠官府赋税徭役在三年以上，而又特别贫困的人，一律都予以免除。
classical: 诸逋负在三年以前尤穷弊者，一皆蠲除。
english: Those who have owed the government taxes and corvée for more than three years, and are particularly destitute, should be exempted.

modern: 陈祗与黄皓内外勾结，黄皓才开始参予政事，多次升迁至中常侍，操弄权柄，终于断送了蜀国。
classical: 祗与皓相表里，皓始预政，累迁至中常侍，操弄威柄，终以覆国。
english: Chen Zhi colluded with Huang Hao, Huang Hao then started to participate in politics, ascended to Mid Constant Attendant on many occasions, and manipulated power, and finally brought the end of the Shu State.

modern: 在这年十月里三次战斗三败贼寇，接着就逼向耀州锥子山的贼寇，其党羽杀死独行狼、郝临庵后投降了。
classical: 十月三战三败之，遂蹙贼耀州锥子山，其党杀独行狼、郝临庵以降。
english: In October that year, during the three battles, the bandits were defeated three times. Following this, they pushed towards the bandits at the Zhoushan Mountain. The bandits’ followers, after killing "Solitary Wolf" Hao Linan, surrendered.

info: 《太平广记·卷三百零一·神十一》
modern: 李玄说：皇上下诏为前代的功臣、勇士、孝女、贞妇立祠，是为了让后代人学习。
classical: 州牧曰：天子之前代之功臣、烈士、孝女、贞妇之祠者，示劝戒，欲后人仿效之。
english: Li Xuan said: The emperor issued an imperial edict to erect temples for the meritorious officials, warriors, filial daughters and chaste women of previous generations so that people in later times can learn from them.

modern: 秦二世元年秋七月，陈涉在蕲县起义，到达陈地，自立为楚王。
classical: 秦二世元年秋七月，陈涉起蕲。
english: In the seventh month of the autumn of the first year of Qin Er Shi's reign, Chen Sheng rebelled in Qixian, went to Chen, and established himself as the King of Chu.

info: 《徐霞客游记·滇游日记二十四》
modern: 从岭头向西走二里，逐渐下然后越到脊西面，顺着路转南往西走，一里，又往西南翻越那北突的山崖，于是平视石宝山尖，和西峰并列对峙，而白塔高悬其中。
classical: 从岭头西向行二里，稍下而逾脊西，随之南转西向，一里，又西南逾其北突之崖，始平望石宝之尖，与西峰并峙，而白塔高悬其间。
english: From the head of the ridge, walked west for two li, gradually went down and then crossed to the west side of the ridge, followed the road and turned south to the west, one li, and then turned southwest over the north protruding cliff, so we could see the peak of Shibaoshan, standing side by side with Xifeng, and the White Pagoda hanging high among them.

modern: 再留，二十五天后转而顺行，每天运行五十八分之九度，五十八天共运行九度。
classical: 复留，二十五日而顺，日行五十八分之九，五十八日行九度。
english: Remain again, after 25 days turn and move directly, running 9/58 degrees per day, running 9 degrees in 58 days.

modern: 我要以死殉国，还有什么再说的？
classical: 吾以死徇国，夫复何言！
english: I will die for my country, what else is there to say?

modern: 夏原吉说： 浙西各郡，苏州、松江处于最下游，嘉兴、湖州、常州略高，太湖环绕，绵延五百里。
classical: 原吉言： 浙西诸郡，苏、松最居下流，嘉、湖、常颇高，环以太湖，绵亘五百里。
english: Xia Yuangi said: West Zhejiang, Suzhou and Songjiang are located in the lowest reaches, while Jiaxing, Huzhou, Changzhou are slightly higher, the Taihu Lake surrounds them, spanning over 500 li.

modern: 何进不能违反太后意旨，且想诛杀那些为首的。
classical: 进难违太后意，且欲诛其放纵者。
english: He Jin couldn't violate the Empress Dowager's wishes, and he also wanted to execute those who were in charge.

info: 《徐霞客游记·粤西游日记十八》
modern: 石瞪悬在裂缝中，时常有巨石挡在险要之处，就放了梯子越过去，一连上爬了六道梯子，这才越过峡谷登上山坳。
classical: 磴悬其中，时有巨石当关，辄置梯以度，连跻六梯，始逾峡登坳。
english: Some huge stones were stacked in slits between the cliffs, and there was often a stone staircase to get past these dangerous places. I climbed over six stairs and crossed the canyon and reached the mountain pass.

modern: 如今为我打算，我应该怎么办才好？
classical: 今为我计当如何？
english: Plan something for me now, what should I do?

modern: 夹祭就是把已毁庙的神主与没有毁庙的神主都收集到太祖庙裹受祭享，父辈为昭，子辈为穆，孙辈又为昭，这是古代正统的礼法。
classical: 祫祭者，毁庙与未毁庙之主皆合食于太祖，父为昭，子为穆，孙复为昭，古之正礼也。
english: The secondary sacrifice is to collect the gods of the destroyed temples and the gods of the temples that have not been destroyed, and accept them in the Taizu temple. The father is Zhao, the son is Mu, and the grandson is Zhao again. This is the orthodox etiquette of the ancients.

modern: 既出问题又背离正道，可能遭致毁灭，只有了解他们的好坏之别而采取克制态度，才不致于有弊无利。
classical: 既弊既背，将受其毁。必能通其碍而节其流，意可为和中矣。
english: Once a problem arises and deviates from the right path, it may lead to destruction. Only by understanding their pros and cons and taking a restrained attitude can there be no harm but benefit.

modern: 王温舒等人是后起酷吏，治民比趟禹还耍严峻。
classical: 王温舒等后起，治峻禹。
english: Wang Wenshu and others were cruel officials who later emerged, and they treated the people even more strictly than Taoyu.

modern: 张衡《南都赋》说：此处的水有溃、澄、涝、烬，发源于岩穴之间，分布很广，河阔水盛，汇成巨流，湍急奔腾，势如疾风飞箭。
classical: 张衡《南都赋》曰：其川读则滍、澧？浕，发源岩穴，布濩漫汗，漭沆洋溢，总括急趣，箭驰风疾者也。
english: Zhang Heng's "Nan Du Fu" says: The water here has Kui, Cheng, Luo, and Jin, originating from rock caves, widely distributed, with large rivers and abundant water, which converge into a huge current, rushing and rushing, just like the wind and arrow.

modern: 王朔所做的占卜说是起决于日边的云象。
classical: 王朔所候，决于日旁。
english: Wang Shuo's prophecy said that he started to infer from the clouds in the sunset.

modern: 田忌待孙膑以贵客之礼，又把他引荐给齐威王。
classical: 田忌善而客待之，进于威王。
english: Tian Ji treated Sun Bin as a distinguished guest and introduced him to King Qi Wei.

info: 《太平广记·卷二百八十五·幻术二》
modern: 大帝急忙追上老人询问是否属实，老人回答说，那瓜是在土里埋着的，再往下看，只得到了一百钱。
classical: 上追老人至，问之；云：土埋一瓜，拟进。适看，唯得百钱耳。
english: The emperor hurriedly approached the old man to see if this was true. The old man replied that the melon was buried in the earth. Looking further into it, he only recovered a hundred coins.

modern: 如果是肾阳虚弱、不能气化，寒饮停聚膈上，而致干呕的，不能用涌吐法，应当用温法治疗，可用四逆汤。
classical: 若膈上有寒饮，干呕者，不可吐也，急温之，宜四逆汤。
english: If yang-qi of the kidneys is deficient, qi transformation is impaired, and cold fluids accumulate above the diaphragm, resulting in dry vomiting, the method of inducing vomiting should not be applied. Instead, the method of warming should be applied, and the Si Ni Tang can be used.

info: 《三国志·吴书·程黄韩蒋周陈董甘淩徐》
modern: 由此两位母亲深受感悟相处和睦。
classical: 由是二母感寤雍穆。
english: The two mothers were deeply moved by this and lived together in harmony.

info: 《三国志·魏书·袁张凉国田王邴管传》
modern: 田畴将自己家中亲属和三百多户族人安置在邺城。
classical: 畴尽将其家属及宗人三百馀家居邺。
english: Tian Chou resettled his relatives and more than 300 clan members in Ye city.

info: 《太平广记·卷一百七十五·幼敏》
modern: 他的父亲林肃是闽府的大将，性格快乐善良，尤其喜欢收藏书籍，又精通下围棋，当时的社会名流都愿意和他结交。
classical: 时肃为闽府大将，性乐善，尤好聚书，又妙于手谭，当时名公多与之交。
english: His father, Lin Su, was a general of the Fujian Mansion, with a happy and kind personality. He especially liked collecting books, and he was also proficient in playing Go. The social celebrities at that time were willing to make friends with him.

modern: 太平竭力为之辩解说： 堂堂宰相怎会干这等事，四海闻之，于国体有损。
classical: 太平力为解之，曰： 堂堂宰相乌得有此事，四海闻之，若国体何！
english: Taiping defended him vigorously and said, "How could a prime minister do such a thing? If the four seas hear about it, it will damage the national image."

modern: 假使才能相同，应当以学习原则的儒生为高，如比对于文吏，就像用水洗污泥，用火烧去腥味一样，水与火，是原则，运用它的人，是处理具体事情的，处理具体事情对于原则只是细枝末节。
classical: 假使材同，当以道学。如比於文吏，洗泥者以水，燔腥生者用火。水火，道也，用之者，事也，事末於道。
english: Supposed that the talent is equal, the Confucian scholars who study principles should be ranked higher, they are like water that washes off mud and fire that burns off stink, water and fire are principles, those who use them deal with concrete issues, dealing with concrete issues is trivial in comparison with principles.

modern: 又平时搜括财物，接受贿赠，士卒为此骚扰百姓而不可禁止。
classical: 又居常裒刻，纳其馈献，士卒因之以扰良民而莫可制。
english: In addition, they often extort money and accept bribes in peacetime, and the soldiers harass the people because of this, and they cannot be stopped.

modern: 庚寅，窦建德攻陷赵州，捉住唐总管张志昂及张道源。
classical: 庚寅，窦建德陷赵州，执总管张志昂及道源。
english: On gengyin day, Dou Jiande conquered Zhao Prefecture and captured Tang Chief Director Zhang Zhiang and Zhang Daoyuan.

modern: 这是由于陛下对待臣子还没有完全做到真诚信任，虽然有善始的勤俭，却没有坚持善终的缘故。
classical: 由乎待下之情未尽于诚信，虽有善始之勤，未睹克终之美故也。
english: This is because Your Majesty has not yet fully achieved genuine trust in your subjects. Although Your Majesty has been diligent and frugal from the beginning, you have not been able to persevere and follow through.

modern: 郭氏的遗产都一并给亲生儿子继承，那些诉讼的人与朋比为奸的人，交给司法官按刑律定罪。
classical: 其生涯并付亲子，所讼人与朋奸者，委法官以律定刑。
english: The entire Guo family fortune was inherited by her biological son; those who filed lawsuits and those who colluded with each other were handed over to the magistrate to be convicted in accordance with the Criminal Code.

modern: 三月十三日，以秘书监崔汉衡为上都留守，右散骑常侍于颀为京兆尹。
classical: 三月甲申，以秘书监崔汉衡为上都留守，右散骑常侍于颀为京兆尹。
english: On March 13th, Cui Hànheng, the director of the Secretary of State, was appointed as the prefect of Shangdu, and Yu Qi, the right-hand guard of the imperial guards, was appointed as the governor of Jingzhao.

modern: 阚棱摘下头盔对敌军说道： 你们不认识我吗？
classical: 阚稜免胄谓贼众曰： 汝曹不识我邪？
english: Kan Leng took off his helmet and said to the enemy army: Don't you recognize me?

modern: 因此圣人严格选择邻居，特别注意环境的影响。从前周成王做孺子时出外就由周公、邵公、太史佚等人辅佐他；在朝内就大颠、闳夭、南宫适、散宜生等人辅佐，他的左右前后，没有违背礼节之义，所在成王一登上王位，天下空前的太平。
classical: 习与恶人居，不能无为恶，犹生长于楚，不能无楚言也 是以圣人审所与居，而戒慎所习。昔成王之为孺子，出则周公，邵公、太史佚，入则大颠、闳夭、南宫括、散宜生，左右前后，礼无违者，故成王一日即位，天下旷然太平。
english: Hence, a sage would be very particular about choosing his neighbors, and pay much attention to the influence of the environment. For instance, when King Cheng of the Zhou Dynasty was young and out of the palace, he was tutored by the Dukes of Zhou and Shao, and the Grand Historian Yi; within the palace, he was tutored by Dadian, Hong Yao, Nango Shi, and Sanyi Sheng. There was no one at any time who did not follow the rules of propriety, and therefore King Cheng was able to bring unprecedented peace and tranquility to the world.

modern: 在水中跋涉的人用标志来表明深度，如果这种标志不明确，就会使人陷入深水淹死；治理民众的君主用标准来表明政治原则，如果这种标准不明确，就会造成混乱。礼制就是治理民众的标准。违反了礼制，就是昏暗的社会；昏暗的社会，就会大乱。
classical: 礼者，表也。非礼，昏世也；昏世，大乱也。故道无不明，外内异表，隐显有常，民陷乃去。
english: A person wading through water uses signposts to indicate the depth; if these signposts are not clear, he may get into deep water and drown; a ruler governing the people uses criteria to indicate political principles; if these criteria are not clear, disorder will occur. Rites are the criteria for governing the people. Violate the rites and you will have a society of ignorance; in a society of ignorance, there will be great disorder.

modern: 第二年六月初八，明宗长子妥欢帖木儿即皇帝位。
classical: 明年六月己巳，明宗长子妥欢帖木耳即位。
english: On the eighth day of June in the following year, Mingzong's eldest son, Tuo Huan Temuer, became emperor.

modern: 册封诸王彻彻秃为宁远王。
classical: 封诸王彻彻秃为宁远王。
english: The King of Ningyuan was formally enfeoffed as Zhūzhēchē.

modern: 城堡南•对马头岸，从前陆抗驻扎在这里，与羊枯相对抗。
classical: 戍南对马头岸。
english: The southern side of the city faced the Matou Riverbank, where Lu Kang had once stationed his troops to resist Yang Kui.

modern: 赐给他御用的食物但又将他罢免。
classical: 赐御食而罢之。
english: He awarded him with imperial food but dismissed him.

modern: 子懋看幼小君主刚刚即位，私下怀持自保的计谋。使作坊锻造兵器。
classical: 子懋见幼主新立，密怀自全之计，令作部造器杖。
english: Zi Mao saw that the young monarch had just ascended the throne, and he secretly held a plan for self-protection. The workshop was ordered to forge weapons.

info: 《太平广记·卷一百三十二·报应三》
modern: 知礼回来后看见自家的北面有一个大坑，坑里有矛枪立在那里，过不去，又看见侄女和奴婢们抬着一个箱子，箱子里都是用绢丝串的钱，另外放了一些饮食，在坑的东北面。
classical: 知礼所居宅北，见一大坑，其中有诸枪矟攒植，不可得过。见其兄女并婢赍箱，箱内有钱绢，及别置一器饮食，在坑东北。
english: When Zhili came back, he saw a big pit to the north of his home, with spears and lances stood in the pit, making it impossible to pass it. He also saw his nieces and maidservants carrying a box with money 串using silk threads and some food in it to the northeast of the pit.

info: 《新五代史·列传·唐臣传第十四》
modern: 不久王正言患风病，不能做事，景进多次替他说话，纔罢免王正言，任孔谦为租庸使，赐给 丰财赡国功臣 的称号。
classical: 已而正言病风，不任事，景进数以为言，乃罢正言，以谦为租庸使，赐 丰财赡国功臣 。
english: Not long after, Wang Zhengyan suffered from rheumatism, and could not work, Jing Jin spoke up for him several times, then he dismissed Wang Zhengyan, and appointed Kong Qian as the rent and tax envoy, and bestowed upon him the title of "Minister of Abundant Wealth and Stability of the Country".

modern: 它们经常探察路过的妇女，看有漂亮的，就强抢带走，人们不知道它们究竟把这些美女带到了什么地方。
classical: 伺道行妇女有美者，辄盗取，将去，人不得知。
english: They often observed passing women, and if they saw a pretty one, they would forcibly abduct her, and no one knew where they took these beauties.

modern: 认为文采不足为奇的，是棘子成这类人。
classical: 谓文不足奇者，子成之徒也。
english: Those who dismiss literary talent as something common are people like Jizicheng.

modern: 高琏不愿让冯弘南归，就派将领孙漱、高仇出其不意杀了冯弘。
classical: 琏不欲弘南，乃遣将孙漱、高仇等袭杀之。
english: Gao Lian did not want Feng Hong to return south, so he sent the generals Sun Shu and Gao Qiu to kill Feng Hong unexpectedly.

modern: 她又对张硕说： 我本来要给您做妻子，感情可别疏远了。只因为我现在年龄还没有到数，其中稍微有点不协调。等到太岁位于东方卯次的单阏年，我会回来追求您的。
classical: 言： 本为君作妻，情无旷远，以年命未合，且小乖，大岁东方卯，当还求君。
english: She said to Zhang Shuo, "I was originally supposed to be your wife, so don't let our feelings fade away. It is only because I am not yet old enough that things are a little out of sync. When the year of the Single Horse arrives, I will come back to pursue you."

modern: 自从太清年间发生内乱，上天辅助齐国不断对外扩张，国家祇能收缩到淮河边上，被敌人大军压境一直到长江北岸。
classical: 自太清之内衅，彼天齐而外侵，始蹙国于淮浒，遂压境于江浔。
english: Ever since the time of internal disorder in the Taiqing period, heaven aided the state of Qi in expanding constantly, the country could only retreat to the Huai River, the border with the enemy army was all the way to the northern bank of the Yangtze River.

modern: 庚午，杨光远上表请求入朝；命刘处让暂时主持天雄军府事。
classical: 庚午，杨光远表乞入朝；命刘处让权知天雄军府事。
english: On the day of the Gengwu, Yang Guangyuan petitioned the court to request to enter the court; Liu Churang was ordered to temporarily preside over the affairs of Tianxiong Junfu.

modern: 所以，贤者对人总是诚信而仁，慈惠而爱，决策广求民意，而不敢先自为定。内心安静，不主张杀伐，道德饶裕，不愿意求索，闲适的形色像女子一样。
classical: 故贤者诚信以仁之，慈惠以爱之，端政象不敢以先人，中静不留，裕德无求，形于女色。
english: Therefore, the virtuous are always sincere and benevolent towards others, kind and loving, seeking the people's opinions in decision-making, and not daring to make decisions for themselves. Calm at heart, not advocating killing, morality abundant, unwilling to seek, leisurely appearance like a woman.

modern: 唉！
classical: 呜呼！
english: Ah!

modern: 家住不轻易出门。
classical: 家居不轻出。
english: He stayed home after that and hardly went out.

modern: 手太肠经，在外可应合于淮水，在内则连属于小肠腑；小肠泌别清浊，而将饮食物所化之糟粕中的水液归于膀胱。手少阳三焦经，在外可应合于漯水，在内则连属于三焦腑。
classical: 手太阳外合于淮水，内属于小肠，而水道出焉。手少阳外合于漯水，内属于三焦。
english: The Hand Taiyang Large Intestine Meridian may correspond with Huai water on the outside and connect with the Small Intestine Organ internally; the Small Intestine separates the clear from the turbid, and sends the water fluids of dietary refuse to the Urinary Bladder. The Hand Shao Yang Triple Energizer Meridian may correspond with Luo water on the outside and connect with the Triple Energizer Organ internally.

modern: 王悦在西藩任上，不幸丧亡。
classical: 受任西籓，不幸致丧。
english: Wang Yue died while in office in the Western Garrison.

info: 《太平广记·卷三百五十三·鬼三十》
modern: 这两个姓陈的人都住在县城的西面。
classical: 二人并居治城之西。
english: Both of these men with the surname Chen resided in the west side of the county town.

info: 《太平广记·卷一百五十五·定数十》
modern: 清回答说： 已经同他说过了，快了，快了！
classical: 答曰： 已说矣，近也近也。
english: Qing answered: I already told him, soon, soon!

modern: 崔干说： 窦建德将至，而宇文化及未平，我军辗转于两贼之间，其势必危，大王又贪图其玉帛财物，必会败亡的啊！
classical: 干曰： 窦建德危至，而化及未平，我转侧两贼间，势必危，王又贪其玉帛，败不日。
english: Cui Gan said: Dou Jiande is almost here, but Yu Huaji hasn't been pacified yet. Our army is caught between the two rebels, and that situation is precarious. If Your Highness persists in coveting their treasure and fine fabrics, you're sure to be defeated!

info: 《三国志·魏书·王毋丘诸葛邓钟传》
modern: 将军蒋班、焦彝，都是诸葛诞的亲信部下，也舍弃了诸葛诞，翻越城墙自行归附大将军司马昭。
classical: 将军蒋班、焦彝，皆诞爪牙计事者也，弃诞，逾城自归大将军。
english: Generals Jiang Ban and Jiao Yi, who were both Zhuge Dan's close associates, left Zhuge Dan, climbed over the city wall and surrendered to General Sima Zhao.

modern: 我听说治理朝政的关键，大致有五个方面：一是慎用刑罚，二是任用贤能，三是亲近忠信，四是疏远谗佞，五是实行黜陟。
classical: 臣闻为治之要，其略有五：一者慎刑罚，二者任贤能，三者亲忠信，四者远谗佞，五者行黜陟。
english: I have heard that there are roughly five key aspects to proper governance: the first is to慎用刑罚，the second is to任用贤能，the third is to亲近忠信，the fourth is to疏远谗佞，and the fifth is to实行黜陟。

modern: 一解我深深思念你却未敢传言，所寄的书信像浮云一去不返。
classical: 郁陶思君未敢言，寄书浮云往不还。
english: First stanza I miss you deeply but dare not spread the word, The letters I sent are like floating clouds, gone and never returned.

modern: 又亲自吊唁致哀。
classical: 便出临哭。
english: Also went to express condolences in person.

modern: 魏博节度使李听到田弘正遇害的消息，身着丧服命令将士说： 魏博人之所能够得到皇上的教化，至今生活安定，富贵享乐，都是田公的功劳。
classical: 魏博节度使李愬闻田弘正遇害，素服令将士曰： 魏人所以得通圣化，至今安宁富乐者，田公之力也。
english: Wei Bo Governor Li heard the news of Tian Hong-Zheng’s death, wore mourning clothes and ordered the soldiers and generals, “That the people of Wei Bo were able to follow the emperor’s education, live  a stable life, and enjoy wealth and honor is all due to Tian Gong’s virtues.”

modern: 八月，会稽郡南部反叛，斩杀都尉。
classical: 八月，会稽南部反，杀都尉。
english: In August, the southern part of Kuaiji County rebelled and killed the governor.

modern: 但重立六国之后，对汉王来说，却是所谓的分割自己拥有的东西去资助敌人，空设虚名而实受崐祸害。
classical: 立六国，于汉王，所谓割己之有而以资敌，设虚名而受实祸也。
english: However, for King Han, after restoring the Six Kingdoms, it was like dividing one's own possessions to support the enemy, setting up an empty name and suffering real harm.

modern: 长孙晟当时在窦荣定军中担任偏将，他派人对阿波可汗说： 沙钵略可汗摄图每次率军侵犯，都能获胜，而你刚率军入侵，很快就失败而归，这是突厥的耻辱。
classical: 长孙晟时在荣定军中为偏将，使谓阿波曰： 摄图每来，战皆大胜。阿波才入，遽即奔败，此乃突厥之耻也。
english: Chnag Sun Sheng was then a general in Dou Rong Ding's army. He sent a man to say to A Ba Ke Han: She Bo Lue Ke Han She Tu every time he led an army to invade, he could win, and you just led an army to invade but quickly failed and returned, this is the shame of the Turks.

info: 《战国策·韩一·张仪为秦连横说韩王》
modern: 张仪为秦国推行连横政策游说韩王说： 韩国地势险恶，处于山区，出产的粮食不是麦子就是豆子；老百姓吃的，大部分是豆做的饭和豆叶做的汤；如果哪一年收成不好，百姓就连酒糟和谷皮都吃不上。土地纵横不到九百里，粮食储备也不够吃两年。
classical: 张仪为秦连横说韩王曰： 韩地险恶，山居，五谷所生，非麦而豆；民之所食，大抵豆饭藿羹；一岁不收，民不餍糟糠；地方不满九百里，无二岁之所食。
english: Zhang Yi lobbied King Han to implement the He Zong policy for the State of Qin: The terrain of the State of Han is rugged and mountainous. The food produced is either wheat or beans; most of what the people eat is bean-based meals and bean leaf soup; if there is a bad harvest in a year, the people will not even be able to eat the fermented bean dregs and rice husks. The land is less than 900 miles long and wide, and there is not enough food reserves for two years.

modern: 所以孔子说： 自身不正，虽有令而不被执行。
classical: 故曰： 其身不正，虽令不行。
english: That is why Confucius said: If one does not correct oneself, even if one issues commands, they will not be carried out.

modern: 考烈王元年，任命黄歇为宰相，封为春申君，赏赐淮北地区十二个县。
classical: 考烈王元年，以黄歇为相，封为春申君，赐淮北地十二县。
english: In the first year of King Kaolie, appointed Huang Xie as Prime Minister, enfeoffed him as Lord of Chunshen, and bestowed twelve counties north of the Huai River upon him.

info: 《太平广记·卷一百五十九·定数十》
modern: 于是他们将姑娘嫁给了裴居道。
classical: 年嫁与之。
english: They thus married the girl to Pei Judao.

modern: 洪熙以后，奉太祖、太宗共同配祀。
classical: 洪熙后，奉太祖、太宗同配。
english: After Hongxi, Taizu and Taizong were jointly consecrated.

modern: 天下人心都向往太子。至元二十二年，世祖年事已高，江南行台监察御史奏请皇上让位给太子。太子闻讯，恐惧万分，台臣也不敢奏报世祖。
classical: 其大雅不群，本于天性，中外归心焉。于是世祖春秋高，江南行台监察御史言事者请禅位于太子，太子闻之，惧。
english: People throughout the country hoped for the prince. In the 22nd year of the Yuan dynasty, the health of the ruling emperor had declined severely, and a supervisory censor of the Southern Dynasty suggested that the emperor grant the throne to the prince. When the prince heard about this, he felt terrified and the ministers in power dared not report it to the emperor.

modern: 甲戌，清晨，慕容会下令严密戒备，在前面引路，继续前进。
classical: 甲戌，旦，会立仗严备，乃引道。
english: On the morning of Jiaxu, Murong Hui ordered strict precautions and led the way forward.

modern: 在这春季正月，圣祖调养受享，用孝顺和恭敬，来成就众民。
classical: 我将我享，维孟之春。以孝以敬，以立我烝民。
english: In the first month of spring, Our Holy Ancestor received nourishment and care through the practice of filial piety and respect, so that he could bestow benefits on all the people.

info: 《太平广记·卷三百二十三·鬼八》
modern: 王某到家以后，立刻点起火把那块木头烧了，烧了之后，也没有再发生什么异常的事，原来那个怪物就是民间所说的山魈。
classical: 王至家，炽火焚之，后寂无复异。
english: Wang went home and immediately lit a fire to burn the piece of wood, after burning it, nothing strange happened again. The monster was just what they call a mountain goblin in folklore.

info: 《徐霞客游记·粤西游日记二十九》
modern: 百感岩前的下洞，在百感岩前洞口之下，路西深坑的肘腋之间。
classical: 百感前下岩，在百感洞前门之下，路西坑腋间。
english: The lower cave in front of Baigan Rock is located under the entrance of the front cave in front of Baigan Rock, and between the armpits of the deep pit in the west of the road.

modern: 钟绍京，虔赣人。
classical: 钟绍京，虔州赣人也。
english: Zhong Shaoqing, was a native of Ganzhou.

modern: 秋七月十九日，葬元帝于渭陵。
classical: 秋七月丙戌，葬渭陵。
english: On July 19, Emperor Yuan was buried in Weiling Mausoleum.

modern: 独有一位县令所派的人不肯随即离去，要求必须有转运使的回信；转运使身边的人劝他走，他都不听，以致呵斥驱逐也不走，还说： 宁可得罪，拿不到回信不敢回县里去。
classical: 有一县令使人，独不肯去，须责回书；左右谕之皆不听，以至呵逐亦不去，曰： 宁得罪；不得书，不敢回邑。
english: But the person dispatched by one particular county magistrate refused to leave immediately, and demanded a reply from the Commissioner of Transportation. The people around the Commissioner of Transportation tried to persuade him to leave but he refused to listen. Even when he was threatened with force he would not leave, and he even said: “I would rather offend someone than return to my county without a reply.”

modern: 攻了三年，没能攻克。
classical: 攻之三年，不能克。
english: After three years of attack, it still couldn't be captured.

modern: 他在郡十七年，政治稳定断案合理，官吏百姓都喜爱他，到朝廷请求为李汉超立碑颂德。
classical: 在郡十七年，政平讼理，吏民爱之，诣阙求立碑颂德。
english: He was in the county for seventeen years, and his politics were stable and reasonable, and officials and people liked him, so he went to the court to ask for a monument for Li Hanchao.

modern: 先月食后交会，看见月食之月合朔时月亮在黄道南则望时月亮在黄道北，合朔时月亮在黄道北则望时月亮在黄道南。交会月食如果在朔望合数六万七千三百一十五以下，则交在前，会在后；如果在入交限敷七十二万二千七百九十五以上，则会在前，交在后。
classical: 交会月蚀如朔望合数以下，则前交后会；如入交限数以上，则前会后交。
english: If there was a conjunction prior to the lunar eclipse, then during the full Moon, the Moon would be north of the ecliptic if it was south of the ecliptic at the conjunction, and south if it was north of the ecliptic at the conjunction. If the conjunction and lunar eclipse occurred before the conjunction of the Sun and the Moon at less than 67315, then the conjunction would occur first, followed by the eclipse. If it occurred after the 722795, then the eclipse would occur first, followed by the conjunction.

modern: 闰月有进退，仍然按定朔没有中气来确定闰月。
classical: 闰有进退，仍以定朔无中气为定。
english: The intercalary month can be advanced or delayed. The intercalary month is still determined with the new moon without the central solar term.

modern: 郁林王在西州，周奉叔自己得以秘密入内，等即位后，他与直阁将军曹道刚为心腹朋友。
classical: 郁林在西州，奉叔密得自进，及即位，与直合将军曹道刚爲心膂。
english: When the King of Yulin was in the Western Zhou mansion, Zhou Fengshu insinuated himself into the king’s confidence. When the king came to the throne, Zhou became one of his closest friends along with a rear guard general by the name of Cao Daogang.

modern: 正好玉清昭应宫发生火灾，王曾于是被逐出京任青州知州。
classical: 会玉清昭应宫灾，乃出知青州。
english: The Yuqing Zhaoying Palace happened to catch fire, so Wang Zeng was expelled from the capital and appointed as the governor of Qingzhou.

info: 《后汉书·列传·刘赵淳于江刘周赵列传》
modern: 虽有仲尼重明周礼，墨子勉以古道，还是不能抵御。
classical: 虽有仲尼重明周礼，墨子勉以古道，犹不能御也。
english: Although Confucius revived the Zhou rituals and Mozi encouraged people along the old paths, they still could not succeed in holding back the trend.

modern: 胥鼎担心敌军在近期内进逼京城，便将河东南路的怀、孟州的军队共一万五千人，由河中入京救援，又派遥授河中府判官的仆散扫吾出带领军队直进陕西，合力抵御。
classical: 鼎虑近薄京畿，遂以河东南路怀、孟诸兵合万五千，由河中入援，又遣遥授河中府判官仆散扫吾出领军趋陕西，并力御之。
english: Xu Ding was worried that the enemy army would approach the capital in the near future, so he sent 15,000 soldiers from Huaizhong and Mengzhou in Hedongnanlu to rescue the capital via Hezhong, and sent Pu San, who was appointed the clerk of Hezhong Fupan, to lead troops directly to assist in defending Shaanxi.

modern: 无穷回答： 我不知道。
classical: 无穷曰： 吾不知。
english: Wuqiong replied: I do not know.

modern: 明帝也不想他们呆在朝廷，一次和缓地对他们说： 你们碰到残暴的国君，辛苦了很长时间，艰苦和欢乐总在循环，你们应该挑选一个养老度日的好地方，有兵马的大镇由你们挑选。
classical: 上亦不欲使其居中，从容谓之曰： 卿等遭罹暴朝，勤劳日久，苦乐宜更，应得自养之地。兵马大郡，随卿等所择。
english: Emperor Ming also did not want them to stay at court. One time he told them gently: "You have suffered a long time under a tyrannical ruler. Hardship and happiness always cycle. You should choose a good place to retire. You can choose from either a town with troops or a large garrison."

modern: 据《周礼考工记》，王宫布局左边是宗庙，右边是社稷。历代遵循这个制度，所以束汉洛阳宫殿布局，社稷在宗庙之右，到东置又是这样。
classical: 《礼》，左宗庙，右社稷，历代遵之，故洛京社稷在庙之右，而江左又然也。
english: According to the “Zhouli Kaogongji”, the left side of the palace is the ancestral temple and the right side is the Sheji. All dynasties have followed this system, so in the layout of the Eastern Han and Luoyang palaces, Sheji is on the right of the ancestral temple, and it is still the same in the Eastern Jin Dynasty.

info: 《太平广记·卷二百一十三·画四》
modern: 画定后，他常常在梦中见到这位天王到他这儿来。
classical: 常于梦中见其形像。
english: After the painting was finished, he often saw this Heavenly King coming to him in his dreams.

modern: 二十六日，汴州总管王要汉在杞州打败徐圆朗，俘虏周文举。
classical: 戊寅，汴州总管王要汉败徐圆郎于杞州，执周文举。
english: On the 26th, Wang Yaohan, the General Manager of Bianzhou, defeated Xu Yuanlang in Qizhou and captured Zhou Wenju.

modern: 把甬长分为三等分，二等分在上，一等分在下，就在上下两段之际设置旋。
classical: 参分其甬长，二在上，一在下，以设其旋。
english: Divide the length of Yong into three equal parts, with two parts on the top and one part on the bottom, and place the spiral between the upper and lower parts.

modern: 当年，吐谷浑慕瞐死去。
classical: 是岁，吐谷浑慕璝死。
english: That year, the leader of Tǔyùhún Mùxian died.

modern: 陆续说： 我母亲切肉无不方方正正，切葱也总是一寸长短。
classical: 续曰： 母截肉未尝不方，断葱以寸为度，故知之。
english: Lu Xu said: My mother would always cut meat into neat and tidy squares, and she would always cut scallions to be one inch long.

modern: 文宣帝因此深深地记恨他。
classical: 帝心衔之。
english: Emperor Wenxuan hated him deeply because of this.

modern: 但这不是使臣的过错，而是通晓此事的人引导使臣妄奏的结果，应该惩治。
classical: 然此非使臣罪，乃通事者导之妄奏，安惩。
english: But this was not the envoy's fault, but the result of someone who knew about this matter leading the envoy to make a false request, and he should be punished.

modern: 四夷使臣来中国的，人数从来没有这么多过。
classical: 四夷之使中国，其众未尝多此。
english: There had never been such a large group of foreign envoys come to China before.

modern: 二十七日，重新以五帝、神州地袄等十三祭为大祀。
classical: 辛卯，复以五帝、神州地祇等十三祭为大祀。
english: On the 27th, the thirteen sacrifices such as the Five Emperors, the Divine Land, and the Armor of the Earth were重新used as great sacrifices.

modern: 彭吴开通入秽貊、朝鲜的道路，设置了沧海郡，燕齐之间如风靡草偃一般骚动起来。
classical: 彭吴贾灭朝鲜，置沧海之郡，则燕齐之间靡然发动。
english: Peng Wu cleared the paths into Wuji Mo and Chaoxian, set up Canghai County, which made the regions between Yan and Qi move like the swaying of grasses in the wind.

modern: 朝廷加封他为侍中，赏赐一套衣物，让他乘上一匹黄马，以表彰他的功绩和才能。
classical: 加侍中，赐衣一袭，乘黄马一匹，以旌其能。
english: The court awarded him an additional title of Chamberlain, rewarded him with a set of clothes, and let him ride a yellow horse to honor his achievements and talents.

modern: 谧号称为贞。
classical: 谥曰贞。
english: His posthumous title was Zhen.

modern: 桓公派遣鲍叔去鲁国议和，对鲁国说： 公子纠，是亲人，请您们替我国杀掉。
classical: 公乃使鲍叔行成，曰： 公子纠，亲也。请君讨之。
english: Duke Huan sent Bao Shu to Lu state to negotiate peace, and said to Lu state: Duke Jiu, is a relative, please kill him for our state.

info: 《太平广记·卷三百六十八·精怪一》
modern: 游先朝
classical: 游先朝
english: You Xianchao

modern: 张吾贵每一次讲唱经书，门徒都达数千人，其中德行学业可以称许的很少。
classical: 吾贵每一讲唱，门徒千数，其行业可称者寡。
english: Every time Zhang Wugui preached, there were thousands of disciples. However, among them, very few of them’s moral character and scholarship were praiseworthy.

modern: 文帝看了非常高兴，将这件事公布于天下。
classical: 上大悦，告天下。
english: The Emperor Wen was very happy when he saw this, and he announced it to the world.

modern: 诏令到达之日一月之内，将织布机全部焚毁。
classical: 敕到一月，机杼一切焚弃。
english: All looms shall be destroyed within one month from the date of receipt of the edict.

modern: 十二月六日，赈济陕西遭侵掠和山东矿贼抢劫之平民。
classical: 十二月戊寅。振陕西被寇及山东矿贼流劫者。
english: On December sixth, relief was given to the people of Shaanxi who had been robbed by foreign invaders and those of Shandong who had been robbed by mine thieves.

modern: 三年，下诏革除众神封号，只有孔子的封爵依旧。
classical: 三年，诏革诸神封号，惟孔子封爵仍旧。
english: In the third year, an edict was issued to remove the titles of all the gods, except for Confucius, whose title remained unchanged.

modern: 说什么 顺从我的就能得到好处，不顺从我的只能得到祸害 。
classical: 曰： 与我者将利之，不与我者将害之。
english: What do you say You will get benefits if you obey me, and you will only get harm if you disobey me.

modern: 这时，寇占据河套，连年派遣大军征讨，没有什么实际效果。
classical: 是时，寇据河套，岁发大军征讨，卒无功。
english: At that time, Kou occupied Hetao and sent large armies to attack every year, but failed to achieve significant results.

modern: 继而告主人已吃饱。
classical: 尸告饱。
english: He then tells the host that he is full.

info: 《太平广记·卷四百八十二·蛮夷三》
modern: 男人和妇女都佩带着带子。
classical: 丈夫妇人俱佩带。
english: Both men and women wore belts.

modern: 汉王也因此让张良厚赠项伯，使项伯代他请求项王将汉中地区分给他。
classical: 汉王亦因令良厚遗项伯，使请汉中地。
english: For this reason, Han Wang also had Zhang Liang give Xiang Bo a large gift, and have Xiang Bo ask Xiang Wang on his behalf to give him the Han Zhong region.

modern: 当时，有兔子在后宫，查问守门的官，都说没有地方可以进入后宫。
classical: 是时，有兔在后宫，验问门官，无从得入。
english: At that time there was a rabbit in the palace. When the guards at the gate were questioned, they all said that there was no place from which it could have entered the palace.

modern: 晋、鲁、卫联军在莘地追上齐军。
classical: 师从齐师于莘。
english: The allied force of Jin, Lu, and Wei catched up with the Qi army in Shen.

modern: 高宗往南征伐周迪，任用陆山才为军司。
classical: 高宗南征周迪，以山才为军司。
english: Emperor Gaozong went south to conquer Zhou Di and appointed Lu Shancai as the military commander.

info: 《新唐书·本纪·卷四·则天皇后 中宗》
modern: 十二月，免除并州百姓终生的徭役及应缴的绢绫物品。
classical: 十二月，免并州百姓庸、调，终其身。
english: In December, the state peasants of Bingzhou were exempted from all corvée and other miscellaneous silk and satin services for life.

modern: 天子背靠绣有斧文的屏风，面南而立，诸侯面向北而拜见天子，这叫 觐 。
classical: 天子当依而立，诸侯北面而见天子，曰觐。
english: The emperor stood with his back to the screen embroidered with axe patterns, facing the south. The vassals faced the north and paid their respects to the emperor. This was called "Meet".

modern: 宰相李林甫一向忌恨邕，于是连及邕也判罪。
classical: 宰相李林甫素忌邕，因傅以罪。
english: Prime Minister Li Linfu had always been jealous of Yong, so he implicated him and sentenced him to a crime.

modern: 适逢火星在南斗六星位滞留十余天，王导对领军将军陶回说： 南斗是扬州的分野，我将退位来安定上天的谴责。
classical: 会荧惑守南斗经旬，导谓领军将军陶回曰： 斗，扬州之分，吾当逊位以厌天谴。
english: It happened that Mars stayed in the area of the Six Stars of the Southern Dipper for over ten days. Wang Dao said to the general of the armed esocrt, Tao Hui: "The Southern Dipper is the field of Yangzhou, and I will resign to alleviate the gods' condemnation."

modern: 揣摩试探，是一种与 揣情 相类似的方法。
classical: 摩者，揣之术也。
english: Guessing and probing is a method similar to probing.

modern: 兵多的达到三千人，兵少的也有千余人，随气候水草变化而游牧。
classical: 兵多者三千，少者千余，逐寒暑，随水草畜牧。
english: The larger ones had as many as 3,000 soldiers, while the smaller ones had more than 1,000 soldiers, who migrated with the changing climate and vegetation.

info: 《太平广记·卷三百四十三·鬼二十》
modern: 曾经臂带一鹞站在路口，看见二个穿紫衣的人，叫道：你不是李努眼的儿子名叫和子的吗？
classical: 常臂鹞立於衢，见二人紫衣，呼曰，尔非李努眼子名和子乎？
english: Once at the crossroads, he was wearing a hawk on his arm and watching when he saw two people wearing purple who called out: Are you not the son of Li Nuyan who is called Hezi?

modern: 陛下上承于天的帝位已经确定，太上皇回来，不再管理天下的事务，陛下只是尊敬奉养他，那么天伦深厚而眷爱更加隆重，实在是古往今来的重大事情。
classical: 陛下天位已定，太上皇还，不复莅天下事。陛下第崇奉之，则天伦厚而天眷益隆，诚古今盛事也。
english: Your Majesty's position on the throne of the son of heaven has been decided, if the Tai shang huang returns, he will no longer manage the affairs of the world, Your Majesty will only respect and support him, then the kinship will be deep and the love will be more earnest, this is truly a major event in history.

modern: 治国要上下和睦，治军兵法令严明，临阵要明察情况。
classical: 居国和，在军法，刃上察。
english: In governing the country, there must be harmony between the top and bottom. In governing the army, the military law and orders must be strict. Facing the battle array, one must have a clear understanding of the situation.

modern: 孙彦先说： 虹是雨中太阳的影子，太阳照雨就会有虹出现。
classical: 孙彦先云： 虹，雨中日影也，日照雨即有之。
english: Sun Yanxian said: A rainbow is the shadow of the sun in the rain, and when the sun shines on the rain, a rainbow appears.

modern: 人君行事失去协调，则国家教化的成果必然流失，流失则国家混乱失败；人臣行事失去协调，则百姓的生活不能供养，不能供养则离散逃亡。
classical: 君失音则风律必流，流则乱败。臣离味则百姓不养。百姓不养，则众散亡。
english: When the ruler's actions are not in harmony, the state's teachings will necessarily be lost; when the teachings are lost, the state will be disordered and defeated; when the minister's actions are not in harmony, the people's livelihood cannot be supported; when the livelihood cannot be supported, the people will be scattered and flee.

modern: 四日，昭义节度使李承昭与卢子期在磁州清水县大战，大破敌军，活捉卢子期献给朝廷。
classical: 甲子，昭义节度使李承昭与卢子期战于磁州清水县，大破之，生擒子期以献。
english: On the 4th day, Zhaoyi's military governor, Li Chengzhao, and Lu Ziqi fought a fierce battle in Qingshui County, Cizhou. They greatly defeated the enemy army, captured Lu Ziqi alive and presented him to the court.

modern: 别部大人刘库仁勇敢而有智谋，铁弗卫辰狡猾多变，都不能单独任用。
classical: 其别部大人刘库仁勇而有智，铁弗卫辰狡猾多变，皆不可独任。
english: Liu Kuliren, an official of the other tribe, is brave and resourceful, and Tie Fuweichen is cunning and changeable. Neither of them could be single-handedly employed.

modern: 余善白刻了有 武帝 字样的玺印，自立为帝，欺骗他的国人，散布狂妄自大的言论。
classical: 馀善刻 武帝 玺自立，诈其民，为妄言。
english: Yu Shan had a seal made, on which the words “Wudi” were engraved. He proclaimed himself emperor and deceived his people by indulging in vainglorious talk.

modern: 淳于衍的丈夫赏是掖庭户卫，对淳于衍说 你去向霍夫人辞行，替我讨个安池监的职位。
classical: 衍夫赏为掖庭户卫，谓衍： 可过辞霍夫人行，为我求安池监。
english: Chunyu Yan's husband called Shang, served in the guard of the imperial harem. He said to Chunyu Yan, "Go and bid farewell to Lady Huo, and ask her to grant me a position in the Anchi Prison."

modern: 马援又分兵进入无编县，就是王莽的九真亭―到了居风县，首领不肯投降，杀了好几千人，九真方才平定。
classical: 援又分兵入无编县，王莽之九真亭。至居风县，帅不降，并斩级数十百，九真乃靖。
english: Ma Yuan divided his troops and entered Wubian County, which was Wang Mang's Jiuzhen Pavilion-When he arrived at Ju Feng County, the leader refused to surrender, and several thousand people were killed, so Jiuzhen was finally settled.

modern: 数日后，又改任黔州刺史、黔州观察使。
classical: 数日，改黔州刺史、黔州观察使。
english: A few days later, he was changed to the posts of Prefect of Qianzhou and Observation Envoy of Qianzhou.

modern: 希望您从我的话中自己选取治理齐国政事的道理。
classical: 愿王之自取齐国之政也。
english: I hope you can choose the morals of Qi's political affairs from my words.

modern: 盛道儿忽然在天空中愤怒地说道： 我在快要断气身亡的时候，把我全家的命运托付给了你，你怎么能昧着良心见利忘义，把我的女儿嫁给贫寒人家成婚呢！
classical: 忽一夜，闻屏风后有鬼谓腹中鬼曰： 何不速杀之。
english: Sheng Da'er suddenly said angrily in the sky: When I was about to die, I entrusted the fate of my family to you. How could you marry my daughter to a poor family for profit and forget your conscience?

modern: 当初，马希萼进入长沙，彭师虽然免于死刑，但仍背受杖刑废黜为民。
classical: 初，马希萼入长沙，彭师暠虽免死，犹杖背黜为民。
english: When Ma Xichong had first entered Changsha, although Peng Shi had been spared the death penalty, he suffered the humiliation of flogging and was stripped of his position.

info: 《太平广记·卷四百二十六·虎一》
modern: 那人说： 可以。
classical: 其人曰： 可也。
english: The man said: Alright.

modern: 静公没有即位就死了。
classical: 静公不享国而死。
english: Jing Gong died before ascending to the throne.

info: 《史记·七十列传·万石张叔列传》
modern: 文帝也称赞提拔了他，逐渐升至太中大夫。
classical: 文帝称举，稍迁至太中大夫。
english: Emperor Wen of Han also praised him and promoted him, gradually to Tai Zhong Da Fu.

info: 《太平广记·卷二百八十一·梦六》
modern: 梦游上
classical: 梦游上
english: Sitting around in a dream

modern: 然后召来与他共坐，仔细观察他的素质，以便了解他的成功成事之处。
classical: 乃召而与之坐，省相其质，以参其成功成事。
english: He then summoned him to sit with him and carefully observed his qualities so as to understand his accomplishments.

modern: 到王师范派刘寻阝占据了兖州，梁太祖令牛存节率兵讨伐，房知温在夜晚用绳子拴着自己吊出城投奔，牛存节高兴地接纳了他，第二天夜晚，房知温偷窃了四匹好马，又进入了兖州城里。
classical: 及王师范遣刘鄩据兗州，梁祖命存节将兵讨之，知温夕缒出奔，存节喜而纳焉。明夜，窃良马一驷，复入城，鄩乃擢为裨将。
english: After Wang Shifan sent Liu Shunfu to occupy Yanzhou, Emperor Taizu of Liang ordered Niu Cunjie to lead the troops to fight against this, Fang Zhiwen took a rope to tie himself at night, and climbed down the city wall to escape to Niu Cunjie, Niu was happy to accept him, the next night, Fang Zhiwen stole four good horses and returned to Yanzhou City.

modern: 俞大猷驻扎武平，建 读易轩 ，与当地读书人一起举办文会，诗词唱和，每天还要教授武士击剑。
classical: 莅武平，作读易轩，与诸生为文会，而日教武士击剑。
english: Yu Dayou stationed his troops in Wuping, established the Du Yi Xuan (Academy of Studying the Book of Changes), and held literary gatherings with local scholars, where they recited poetry and exchanged verses. He also instructed his soldiers in fencing every day.

modern: 洛水又与掳水汇合。藐水发源于扶猪之山，北流注入洛水。
classical: 洛水又与虢水会，水出扶猪之山，北流注于洛水。
english: Luo River joins with Luo River. Miao River originates from Fu Zhu Mountain flowing north into Luo River.

modern: 二十日，立从前新蔡王司马晃的弟弟司马崇为新蔡王。
classical: 庚午，立前新蔡王晃弟崇为新蔡王。
english: On the twentieth day, Sima Chong, the younger brother of Sima Huang (the former King of Xincai), was enfeoffed as the new King of Xincai.

modern: 闲暇的日子，与夫人较量他们的法术效用。
classical: 暇日，常与夫人较其术用。
english: In leisure time, he competes with his wife for the effectiveness of their spells.

info: 《太平广记·卷三百一十七·鬼二》
modern: 一看女子家很穷，但还是给吴祥做了饭。
classical: 行一里余。
english: At a glance, the young woman's house was shabby, but she still made some food for Wu Xiang.

info: 《国语·周语·祭公谏穆王征犬戎》
modern: 这难道不是废弃先王的遗训而使王业败坏吗？
classical: 其无乃废先王之训而王几顿乎！
english: Is this not a way to destroy the legacy of the former kings and ruin your royal undertakings?

modern: 中元元年，武都的参狼羌反叛，杀害和掠夺官吏百姓，太守与参狼羌交战，未能取胜，陇西太守刘盱派从事辛都、监军掾李苞率领五千人赶到武都，与羌人作战，杀了羌人的头领，杀死并俘虏羌人共一千多。
classical: 中元元年，武都参狼羌反，杀略吏人，太守与战不胜，陇西太守刘盱遣从事辛都、监军掾李苞，将五千人赴武都，与羌战，斩其酋豪，首虏千余人。
english: In the first year of Zhongyuan, Canlang Qiang of Wudao rebelled, killing and looting officials and common people. The prefect fought with Canlang Qiang, but failed to win. The Longxi prefect Liu Xu sent Xindu the assistant and the military supervisor Li Bao to lead 5,000 people to Wudao to fight against the Qiang people. They killed the leader of the Qiang people and killed and captured more than 1,000 of them.

modern: 充人掌管系养祭祀所用的完好而纯色的牲。
classical: 充人掌系祭祀之牲牷。
english: The responsible individual for managing and rearing the perfect and pure-colored sacrificial oxen.

modern: 冬季无雪。
classical: 冬，无雪。
english: There was no snow in winter.

modern: 呴犁湖单于继位一年就死去，匈奴便立他的弟弟左大都尉且鞮侯当了单于。
classical: 呴犁湖单于立一岁死。匈奴乃立其弟左大都尉且鞮侯为单于。
english: Chanyu Xulihu died a year after he took the throne, and the Huns made his younger brother, the Left General, Qiedihou, as Chanyu.

modern: 王恭临死时，还在从容不迫的梳理着自己的胡须，神色像平时那样自然。他对监督施刑的人说： 我自己的昏庸就在于我轻率地相信别人，才到了今天这个地步。不过追究我的本意，我哪里是不忠于朝廷呵！
classical: 恭临刑，犹理须鬓，神色自若，谓临刑者曰： 我暗于信人，所以至此，原其本心，岂不忠于社稷邪！
english: Before he died, Wang Gong calmly combed his beard, and his expression was as natural as usual. He said to the people who were overseeing his execution: "My stupidity was in trusting others too lightly, which is why I am in this situation today. But if you look at my true intentions, how could I be disloyal to the court?"

modern: 第二年五月，敌人进犯盘山驿，指挥苏成勋打跑了他们。
classical: 明年五月，敌犯盘山驿，指挥苏成勋击走之。
english: In May of the second year, the enemy invaded Panshanyi, and the commander Su Chengxun repelled them.

modern: 常州义兴县有个鳏夫吴堪，少年丧父又无兄弟，在县衙当小官吏，为人性情恭顺。
classical: 常州义兴县，有鳏夫吴堪，少孤无兄弟，为县吏，性恭顺。
english: There was a widower in Yixing County in Changzhou named Wu Kan. He lost his father when he was young and had no brothers. He served as a minor official in the county government and was of a docile nature.

modern: 入朝为都官尚书令。
classical: 入为都官尚书令。
english: He entered the court and became the Shangshu of the State Officials.

modern: 伟大的光辉普照下来，照亮了一切没有止境。
classical: 大明垂曜，旁烛无疆。
english: Great brilliance shines down, illuminating everything without end.

modern: 往日，内外作乱的罪犯、杀人的罪犯、虏人的罪犯，要宽恕；往日，洩露国君大事的罪犯、残坏人体的罪犯，也要宽恕。
classical: 肆往，奸宄、杀人、历人，宥；肆亦见厥君事、戕败人，宥。
english: In the past, those who committed crimes of internal or external rebellion, crimes of murder, and crimes of kidnapping shall be pardoned; in the past, those who committed crimes of treason, and those who committed crimes of disfiguring someone’s body shall also be pardoned.

modern: 南唐君主于是任命营屯都虞候边镐为信州刺史，领兵屯驻袁州，暗中谋划进攻夺取湖南。
classical: 唐主乃以营屯都虞候边镐为信州刺史，将兵屯袁州，潜图进取。
english: The lord of southern Tang then appointed the patrol inspector of the military camp Bian Hao as the magistrate of Xinyang and led his troops to garrison in Yuanzhou, secretly planning to attack and seize Hunan.

info: 《史记·七十列传·屈原贾生列传》
modern: 怀王大怒，不肯应允。
classical: 怀王怒，不听。
english: King Huái was furious and refused to agree.

modern: 对上尊敬祖宗，增加祭祖时的礼仪和乐队规模；对下施恩惠给士人、平民以及鳏寡者等无依靠的老人，凡是施恩布德的政策没有不实行的。
classical: 上尊宗庙，增加礼乐；下惠士民鳏寡，恩泽之政无所不施。
english: As for the ancestors, he increased the rituals and music for ancestral sacrifices to show his respect; as for the people, he extended his benevolence to scholars, commoners, widows, orphans, and the old who had no one to depend on; and there was no benevolent policy that he did not implement.

modern: 第七段二十五度三三一五五六二四九二六零一五六二五
classical: 第七段二十五度三三一五五六二四九二六零一五六二五
english: Seventh section is twenty-fifth degree 33155624926015625

modern: 我靠进谏当官，让皇上被全国人非议，请求撞碎脑袋来表歉意。
classical: 臣以谏为官，使陛下负天下讥，请碎首以谢。
english: I rely on persuading to become an official, let Your Majesty be criticized by the whole country, and I request to crush my head to express my apology.

modern: 你快从小路逃走，我死在这里，也就没有遗恨了。
classical: 尔求间道亡归，我死此，无恨矣。
english: Zhu Chao Shi held his brother's hand and said, "Who can't die? How can I bear to say goodbye to you at this time!" Thus, the two brothers, as well as Wang Jingxian and the right-wing staff officer Liu Qinzhi, were captured and escorted to Chang'an.

modern: 二十四日，武平发生饥馑，以二万三千六百石粮食赈济他们。
classical: 庚子，武平饥，以粮二万三千六百石赈之。
english: On the 24th, there was a famine in Wuping and they were given 23,600 bushels of grain to help them.

info: 《太平广记·卷四百八十四·杂传记》
modern: 李娃把钱给老妇人后，还剩有百金。
classical: 给姥之余，有百金。
english: After Li Wa gave the money to the old lady, she still had a hundred gold coins left.

modern: 睿宗庙：迎神，奏《太和之曲》：肃穆神皇，秉凝道德帝业隆。
classical: 睿庙。迎神，《太和之曲》：于穆神皇，秉德凝道。
english: Ruizong Temple: Welcome the God, play the "Taihe Song": Solemn and divine emperor, inheriting the moral virtues.
